lane: independent source-based procedure review; no tests, builds, browser, or runtime calls

evidence: All ten named tools and the supplied arguments match their current Zod handler schemas and catalog input schemas. The signed-in-only Tools tab is confirmed by src/config/sidepanel-visibility.ts:35; ToolsView directly invokes local handlers and documents that manual execution skips the dispatcher permission gate (src/features/tools/ToolsView.tsx:11-14, 453-462). The batch correctly limits its claimed scope to manual-handler behavior and leaves test statuses untouched.
The batch is explicitly design-only. No result establishes runtime behavior, loaded artifact identity, permission enforcement, or completion of an inventory cell.
limitations: Each case lists reload as a dimension, but shared setup performs extension/tab reload before the cases and no case defines separate warm and post-reload executions. PLAN.md: build/reload contract requires warm and cold/reloaded runs; this batch does not yet give executable evidence steps for both.

The inventory records gated/negative permission cases as a readiness gap for these registered-tool features. The batch correctly says the manual Run cannot cover that gate, but the separate dispatch/access cases remain outstanding and must not be cleared by merging these procedures.
No browser or manual tool run was performed; every outcome remains unverified.

case_findings.finding: The no-match control cannot reliably expect an empty matches list. find deliberately sends candidates to AI even when every text-prefilter score is zero (src/lib/tools/handlers/page-refs.ts:606-612), and accepts the AI-provided matches (652-668); only its text fallback guarantees empty output for a zero-score query. The same procedure can therefore return a candidate for the sentinel query.
case_findings.recommendation: Remove the deterministic empty-list assertion for this AI-backed path, or redesign the case around a deterministic source-level boundary that does not depend on AI abstention.

case_findings.finding: The case calls read_active_page a concise summary, but the handler returns the full SoupResult from captureWithFallback (src/lib/tools/handlers/read.ts:106-112; SoupResult includes article content, media, links, structured data, SEO and metadata in src/lib/scrape/pipeline.ts:33-52). Also, deep=true triggers a scroll-to-load pass but does not promise that the returned representation differs from shallow output.
case_findings.recommendation: Describe the result as a structured page capture; assert its known fields and that deep mode requests lazy loading, without requiring a shorter summary or differing output.

case_findings.finding: The lower-bound variable visit-window-start-ms is never assigned. Preconditions say to visit both URLs and record a run-start time, while the call also needs a lower bound preceding those visits. The Chrome query uses start_time_ms/end_time_ms directly (src/lib/tools/handlers/browser-data.ts:100-108), so an operator cannot reproduce the intended window from the written sequence alone.
case_findings.recommendation: Record the lower-bound timestamp immediately before seeding visits, then record the end bound immediately before running the case; specify milliseconds since epoch and keep both numeric JSON values.

verdict_b_source_quality.minor_cross_case_note: read_page stamps and clears data-matrx-ref attributes in the page DOM (src/lib/tools/handlers/page-refs.ts:279-280, 351-352). Its procedure claims no page content is edited, which is true for visible content, but should avoid implying zero DOM mutation.
positive_checks: The provided read_page, find, read_active_page, get_element_details, tabs, bookmark and history arguments conform to the local schemas checked against the implementation/catalog.

The examples use public targets or explicitly synthetic personal-data fixtures, correctly distinguish visible handler errors from successful empty results, and retain member/admin applicability with guest gated at the Tools tab.

status_promotion: None; inventory modes/cells and cases remain unverified.
